text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E in portions at a gain felt satisfying, but I should size sales according to a plan rather than the urge to lock in profits.","My average cost is personal history, not a measure of a stock’s value; I should base decisions on its prospects and my portfolio needs.","Because I check my account only occasionally, I should use a simple review routine and avoid reacting impulsively to short-term price changes."]}
